what: Every obligation of the baseline that has law text, read beside the provisions cited under it by one reader and, where the reader found the text does not simply carry the duty, by a second reader who tried to show that it does. These are the cases that stood. The law texts are not in question; each row is a correction to propose for the obligation (its summary, its title or its citation), through the proposal door.

verdicts.contradicts: the cited text states a number, a date, an actor or a condition differently from the summary
verdicts.incorporation clause only: the cited Norwegian section makes an EU regulation Norwegian law and holds none of the duty's own words, which are in the EU article the citation names
verdicts.partly: the cited text is the right place, but a material element of the summary is not in it and must come from a provision that is not cited

findings.title: Keep a register of financial contracts where the resolution plan requires it
findings.summarySays: Title: "Keep a register of financial contracts where the resolution plan requires it"; summary: "The firm must keep a register of financial contracts with the information set out in Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/1712, where its resolution plan or group resolution plan says so."
findings.textSays: DA: "Virksomheder skal føre et register over finansielle kontrakter. Registeret skal indeholde de oplysninger, der er angivet i ... (EU) 2016/1712 ..., hvis det fremgår af virksomhedens afviklingsplan eller koncernafviklingsplan ..., at virksomheden skal afvikles."
findings.whatToDo: In the Danish text the first sentence is unconditional: every undertaking must keep the register. The "hvis" condition applies only to the 2016/1712 content, and only where the plan shows the undertaking is to be resolved. The title makes the register itself conditional, so retitle it to "Keep a register of financial contracts" and reword the summary to say the 2016/1712 content is required where the resolution plan or group resolution plan shows the firm is to be resolved.

findings.title: Have a systematic training programme completed before staff work with housing credit
findings.summarySays: competence can come from a relevant theoretical course or at least two years' relevant employment
findings.textSays: DA § 5, stk. 3: "Fastsættelse af et fornødent kompetenceniveau kan efter den 21. marts 2019 ikke alene ske på baggrund af kompetencer erhvervet som anført i stk. 2, nr. 2." / EN: "After 21 March 2019, the necessary level of competence may not be determined solely on the basis of competences acquired as set out in subsection (2), no. 2."
findings.whatToDo: Stk. 2 does list the two routes, but stk. 3 means two years' employment alone has not been enough since 21 March 2019, so the summary offers a route the law has closed. Reword: competence comes from a relevant theoretical course; since 21 March 2019, two years' employment alone no longer suffices (§ 5(3)).

findings.title: Check the completeness, accuracy and timeliness of transaction reports and correct errors
findings.summarySays: The firm stays responsible for complete, accurate and timely transaction reports even when it reports through a trading venue or an approved reporting mechanism
findings.textSays: "By way of derogation from that responsibility, where an investment firm reports details of those transactions through an ARM which is acting on its behalf or a trading venue, the investment firm shall not be responsible for failures in the completeness, accuracy or timely submission of the reports which are attributable to the ARM or trading venue. In those cases ... the ARM or trading venue shall be responsible for those failures." (Art. 26(7), third subparagraph)
findings.whatToDo: The first reader is right. The rest of the summary is in the text: the general responsibility ("Investment firms shall have responsibility for the completeness, accuracy and timely submission of the reports"), the duty to "take reasonable steps to verify" reports submitted on the firm's behalf, and the duty to "submit a corrected report". But the claim that the firm stays responsible even when it reports through an ARM or a venue is reversed, because Art. 26(7) moves responsibility for failures caused by the ARM or venue to them. Reword the summary along these lines: the firm is responsible for its reports, except for failures caused by an ARM or trading venue that reports for it; it must still take reasonable steps to verify those reports, and errors must be corrected.

findings.title: Disclose a buy-back programme beforehand and report and publish its trades within seven market sessions
findings.summarySays: since 4 December 2024 MAR Article 5(3) names the authority of the most relevant market in terms of liquidity as the recipient of the reports
findings.textSays: The issuer shall report to the competent authority of each trading venue on which the shares are admitted to trading or are traded no later than by the end of the seventh daily market session
findings.whatToDo: The rest of the summary is carried by Article 2: the prior disclosure in 2(1), recording and reporting in detailed and aggregated form within seven sessions in 2(2), and publication with five years on the website in 2(3). The recipient is the problem. The cited RTS text names every trading venue's authority, while the summary names a single authority (the most relevant market in terms of liquidity) and takes it from amended MAR Article 5(3), which is not cited. Add MAR Article 5(3), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/2809, to the citation so the overriding rule appears next to it. Alternatively, reword the summary to say that the RTS's 'each trading venue' recipient has been superseded by MAR Article 5(3).

findings.title: Publish yearly allocation reports, reviewed after issuance, and an impact report
findings.summarySays: For every 12 months until the proceeds are fully allocated, the issuer must draw up an allocation report on the Annex II template ... and obtain an external post-issuance review of it.
findings.textSays: "Issuers of European Green Bonds shall obtain a post-issuance review by an external reviewer of the allocation report drawn up after the full allocation of the proceeds of the European Green Bond." (Art. 11(4)); only "by way of derogation from paragraph 4, every allocation report by issuers that allocate the proceeds ... to a portfolio of assets shall be subject to a post-issuance review" (Art. 11(6)).
findings.whatToDo: The cited Article 11 carries the yearly Annex II reports (11(1)) and the Article 12(1) impact report duty correctly, but the summary has the external review applying to every yearly report, while 11(4) requires it only for the report after full allocation (plus amended reports under 11(5)), and for every report only under the portfolio approach (11(6)). Reword the summary to that effect; it could also mention the 270-day publication deadline in 11(7).

findings.title: Report regularly to FIN-FSA on each fund managed
findings.summarySays: principal exposures, most important concentrations, leverage and other factors relevant to systemic risk; reporting on each fund's positions and assets applies from 16 April 2027.
findings.textSays: FI: "6) vaihtoehtorahastojen vivutuksesta ja vivutuksen kokonaismäärästä; 6 kohta tulee voimaan 16.4.2027." Also "7 kohta tulee voimaan 16.4.2027.", "8 kohta tulee voimaan 16.4.2027.", "2 momentti tulee voimaan 16.4.2027."
findings.whatToDo: The summary presents leverage reporting as already applying and names only positions and assets (item 3) as starting on 16 April 2027. The cited text gives the same date for item 6 (leverage), items 7 (delegation) and 8 (EEA marketing states), and subsection 2 (identifiers). Reword the summary so that items 3, 6, 7 and 8 and the identifier rule all apply from 16 April 2027, and check which wording of the section is in force today.

findings.title: Attach the information the decree lists to a notice of acquiring or disposing of a qualifying holding
findings.summarySays: A notice of a disposal needs only the notifier's identity or register extract, the target and the holdings before and after.
findings.textSays: 1 § FI: "Tämän asetuksen 3 §:ää, 4 §:n 2 ja 3 momenttia ja 5 §:ää ei sovelleta omistusosuuden luovuttamista koskevaan ilmoitukseen." So all of 4 § subsection 1 applies to a disposal, including 4 § (1) 3) "tiedot ... merkittävästä sidoksesta" (close links), 4) "tiedot ilmoitusvelvollisen ei-taloudellisesta sidonnaisuussuhteesta" (non-financial relationships) and 5) "kohdeyrityksen hankintaan tai luovutukseen liittyvät sopimukset" (the acquisition or disposal agreements).
findings.whatToDo: Confirmed: 1 § excludes only 3 §, 4 § subsections 2-3 and 5 §, so a disposal notice must also carry the 4 § subsection 1 items on close links, non-financial relationships and the disposal agreements. Reword the summary's last sentence to say that a disposal notice needs the identity or register extract (2 § subsection 3) and every item in 4 § subsection 1, but not the further details, financing information or 20 % strategy information.

findings.title: Report frozen accounts and amounts under the Republic of Guinea sanctions to DEKSA without delay
findings.summarySays: A bank must immediately give Direktoratet for eksportkontroll og sanksjoner (DEKSA) ... any information that would facilitate compliance with Regulation (EU) No 1284/2009 (citation: § 2 (Regulation (EU) No 1284/2009 Art. 12(1)))
findings.textSays: NO § 2(6): "Videre er også følgende artikler EU-interne og kommer ikke til anvendelse: 12, 13, 15–19."
findings.whatToDo: The cited § 2(6) says expressly that Art. 12 does not apply in Norway, yet the obligation rests on Art. 12(1). Someone should check against the Norwegian source whether the reporting duty to DEKSA exists in Norway at all. If it does not, retire the obligation. If it does, find the provision that actually imposes it and fix the citation.

findings.title: Screen for politically exposed persons and apply the extra measures when one is found
findings.summarySays: obtain approval from an authorised senior person before establishing or continuing the relationship
findings.textSays: "inhämta godkännande från behörig beslutsfattare inför beslut om att ingå eller avbryta en affärsförbindelse" (EN: "before deciding to enter into or terminate a business relationship")
findings.whatToDo: The other elements are in the cited text: the PEP assessment (3:10), the source of assets and the enhanced monitoring (3:19 points 1 and 2), and family members and close associates (3:19 second paragraph). In the cited Swedish text, approval is needed before a decision to enter into or end (avbryta) the relationship, not before continuing it. Reword the summary to "before deciding to enter into or end the relationship". Whether "senior" stays depends on how the act defines "behörig beslutsfattare": cite that definition or drop the word.

findings.title: Make the management body responsible for the ICT risk management framework
findings.summarySays: Its management body must define, approve, oversee and be responsible for the ICT risk management framework, bear the ultimate responsibility for ICT risk
findings.textSays: "forordning (EU) 2022/2554 ... gjelder som lov med de tilpasninger som følger av vedlegg IX" plus regulation-making powers
findings.whatToDo: An incorporation clause carries none of the governance duty. Cite DORA Art. 5.

findings.title: Maintain a sound, comprehensive and documented ICT risk management framework
findings.summarySays: The firm must have a sound, comprehensive and well-documented ICT risk management framework
findings.textSays: "forordning (EU) 2022/2554 ... gjelder som lov med de tilpasninger som følger av vedlegg IX"
findings.whatToDo: An incorporation clause carries none of the framework duty. Cite DORA Art. 6.

findings.title: Keep a register of all ICT third-party service arrangements and report on them yearly
findings.summarySays: the firm must maintain and update ... a register of information on all contractual arrangements for ICT services ... It must report at least yearly to the competent authority
findings.textSays: "forordning (EU) 2022/2554 ... gjelder som lov med de tilpasninger som følger av vedlegg IX"
findings.whatToDo: An incorporation clause carries no register or reporting duty. Cite DORA Art. 28(1) and (3). § 3(2) of the Act, which is not cited, only empowers supplementary rules on the register.

findings.title: Report major ICT-related incidents to Finanstilsynet
findings.summarySays: The firm must report major ICT-related incidents to the relevant competent authority, which is Finanstilsynet under § 3 of the Act
findings.textSays: § 3(1): "Finanstilsynet er nasjonal tilsynsmyndighet etter DORA-forordningen"; § 3(3): "Departementet kan i forskrift fastsette bestemmelser om rapportering av hendelser" (a regulation power, not a duty)
findings.whatToDo: § 3 only names Finanstilsynet and gives the Ministry powers; § 1 only incorporates DORA. Cite DORA Art. 19 for the reporting duty, keeping § 3 only for naming the authority.

findings.title: Run a digital operational resilience testing programme
findings.summarySays: the firm must establish, maintain and review a sound and comprehensive digital operational resilience testing programme
findings.textSays: "forordning (EU) 2022/2554 ... gjelder som lov med de tilpasninger som følger av vedlegg IX"
findings.whatToDo: An incorporation clause carries none of the testing duty or the microenterprise exception. Cite DORA Art. 24.

findings.title: Send the required payer and payee information with transfers and detect missing information
findings.summarySays: the firm must ensure that transfers of funds carry the information on the payer that Regulation (EU) 2023/1113 requires, such as name, account number and address ... it must have effective procedures to detect whether required information on the payer or payee is missing
findings.textSays: "forordning (EU) 2023/1113 ... gjelder som lov med de tilpasninger som følger av vedlegg IX"; (2) "Departementet kan i forskrift gi regler ... om lagring av personopplysninger utover fem år"
findings.whatToDo: Section 52 only incorporates TFR II and gives a regulation power on retention; no payer/payee information or detection duty is in it. Show TFR (Regulation (EU) 2023/1113) Art. 4 and 7 under this duty, keeping § 52 only as the incorporation link.

findings.title: Notify Finanstilsynet at least 40 working days before first providing crypto-asset services
findings.summarySays: A credit institution may provide crypto-asset services if it notifies the competent authority ... at least 40 working days before providing those services for the first time
findings.textSays: § 1: MiCA "gjelder som lov"; § 2: "Finanstilsynet fører tilsyn med foretak som har tillatelse til å drive virksomhet i kryptoeiendelsmarkedet"
findings.whatToDo: Neither section contains the notification or the 40 working days. Cite MiCA Art. 60(1) and (7), keeping § 2 only for naming Finanstilsynet.

findings.title: Detect market abuse in crypto-assets and report suspicious orders and transactions without delay
findings.summarySays: must have effective arrangements, systems and procedures to prevent and detect market abuse, and must report to the competent authority without delay any reasonable suspicion
findings.textSays: "forordning (EU) 2023/1114 ... gjelder som lov med de tilpasninger som følger av vedlegg IX"; (3) concerns only notifications on delayed disclosure under Art. 88(3)
findings.whatToDo: An incorporation clause carries no surveillance or reporting duty. Cite MiCA Art. 92(1).

findings.title: Notify personal data breaches to Datatilsynet within 72 hours
findings.summarySays: the controller must notify the supervisory authority, which in Norway is Datatilsynet (§ 20), without undue delay and where feasible within 72 hours of becoming aware of it
findings.textSays: § 1: GDPR "gjelder som lov"; § 20: "Datatilsynet er tilsynsmyndighet etter personvernforordningen artikkel 51 og er et uavhengig forvaltningsorgan"
findings.whatToDo: Neither section contains the notification duty, the 72 hours or the risk exception. § 20 only supports naming Datatilsynet as the recipient. Cite GDPR Art. 33 for the duty.

findings.title: Keep a record of the processing activities under the firm's responsibility
findings.summarySays: As a controller, the firm must keep a record of the processing activities it is responsible for, including its contact details and those of its data protection officer, the purposes of processing ...
findings.textSays: "forordning (EU) 2016/679 ... (generell personvernforordning) gjelder som lov med de tilpasningene som følger av vedlegg XI"
findings.whatToDo: Section 1 is only the GDPR incorporation clause. Re-point the duty to GDPR Art. 30, keeping § 1 only as the incorporation link.

findings.title: Give retail investors the key information document in good time before they are bound
findings.summarySays: must provide retail investors with the key information document in good time before they are bound by any contract or offer
findings.textSays: "PRIIPs-forordningen ... gjelder som lov"; "Departementet kan i forskrift gi nærmere regler ... om plikten til å gjøre nøkkelinformasjon tilgjengelig"
findings.whatToDo: § 2 incorporates PRIIPs and gives a regulation power; it contains no delivery duty or timing. Cite PRIIPs Art. 13(1).

findings.title: Describe in pre-contractual disclosures how sustainability risks are integrated and their likely impact
findings.summarySays: must describe in pre-contractual disclosures how sustainability risks are integrated into their investment decisions and the likely impact of those risks on the returns
findings.textSays: "offentliggjøringsforordningen ... gjelder som lov med de tilpasninger som følger av vedlegg IX"
findings.whatToDo: An incorporation and scope clause carries none of the pre-contractual disclosure duty. Cite SFDR Art. 6.

findings.title: Publish a statement on principal adverse sustainability impacts, or explain why they are not considered
findings.summarySays: must publish and keep on their websites either a statement on their due diligence policies for the principal adverse impacts ... or clear reasons why they do not consider such impacts
findings.textSays: "offentliggjøringsforordningen ... gjelder som lov med de tilpasninger som følger av vedlegg IX"
findings.whatToDo: An incorporation and scope clause carries none of this statement duty. Cite SFDR Art. 4(1).

findings.title: Publish on the website how sustainability risks are integrated in investment decisions or advice
findings.summarySays: Financial market participants must publish on their websites their policies on integrating sustainability risks into investment decisions
findings.textSays: "offentliggjøringsforordningen ... gjelder som lov"; "Offentliggjøringsforordningen skal også gjelde for forsikringsformidlere og verdipapirforetak"
findings.whatToDo: Only the summary's scope sentence on intermediaries and investment firms is carried; the website publication duty is not. Cite SFDR Art. 3, keeping § 2 only for the scope extension.

findings.title: Give the user the prescribed information when a payment services framework contract is concluded
findings.summarySays: and it bears the burden of proving that it met the information requirements (§ 65)
findings.textSays: DA: "En udbyder af betalingstjenester skal, senest samtidig med at en rammeaftale om en betalingstjeneste indgås, meddele brugeren følgende oplysninger:" Nowhere in stk. 1 to 5 does § 72 say anything about the burden of proof (bevisbyrde).
findings.whatToDo: The first reader is right. § 72 carries the information list and the timing in full. The burden-of-proof element is a separate rule that the summary itself places in § 65, which is not cited. Add § 65 to the citation, or remove the burden-of-proof sentence from the summary.

findings.title: Refund unauthorised payment transactions by the end of the next business day
findings.summarySays: The payer bears losses only within the limits of § 100, for example up to DKK 375 where the personalised security credential was used, and objections must reach the provider within 13 months of the debit (§ 97).
findings.textSays: DA: "Betalerens udbyder af betalingstjenester hæfter i forhold til betaleren for tab som følge af uautoriserede betalingstransaktioner, jf. § 97, medmindre andet følger af § 100." § 99 states no amount and no objection period; DKK 375 and 13 months appear nowhere in its four subsections.
findings.whatToDo: The first reader is right. § 99 carries the provider's liability, the refund by the end of the next working day and the fraud exception with notice to Finanstilsynet. The DKK 375 cap and the 13-month objection period come only from §§ 100 and 97, which § 99 points to but which are not cited. Add § 100 and § 97 to the citation, or cut those two elements from the summary.

findings.title: Notify significant incidents within 24 hours, update within 72 hours and report finally within a month
findings.summarySays: The Act does not apply where sector-specific EU acts and their national implementation have at least the same effect as its rules on risk management and incident notification (§ 1(3)), which financial entities under DORA, Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, should check first.
findings.textSays: § 12 stk. 1: "skal underrette den relevante kompetente myndighed og Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) om enhver væsentlig hændelse"; § 13 stk. 1 nr. 1, 2 and 4 give "senest inden for 24 timer", "inden for 72 timer" and "senest 1 måned efter fremsendelsen af den hændelsesunderretning". Neither section says anything about sector-specific EU acts, DORA or an exclusion.
findings.whatToDo: The duty to notify, who receives the notifications and the 24-hour, 72-hour and one-month deadlines all match the summary exactly. Only the scope exclusion is missing: it comes from the uncited § 1, stk. 3. Add dk-lov-2025-434/001 to the citation, or take the sentence out of the summary and put it in an applicability note.

findings.title: Take cybersecurity risk-management measures approved and overseen by management
findings.summarySays: The Act does not apply where sector-specific EU acts and their national implementation have at least the same effect as its rules on risk management and incident notification (§ 1(3)), which financial entities under DORA, Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, should check first.
findings.textSays: § 6 stk. 1: "Væsentlige og vigtige enheder skal træffe passende og forholdsmæssige tekniske, operationelle og organisatoriske foranstaltninger..."; § 7: "skal være godkendt af enhedens ledelsesorgan. Ledelsesorganet fører tilsyn..." and stk. 2 on training. Neither § 6 nor § 7 (stk. 1-3 and stk. 1-2) mentions sector-specific EU acts, DORA or any exclusion from the Act.
findings.whatToDo: The measures, management approval, oversight and training are fully carried by §§ 6-7, but the sector-specific exclusion the summary states (decisive for banks under DORA) comes only from the uncited § 1, stk. 3. Add dk-lov-2025-434/001 (§ 1(3)) to the citation so its text is shown, or move that sentence out of the summary into an applicability note.

findings.title: Report reportable accounts to the tax administration by 1 May
findings.summarySays: The list of participating jurisdictions in Annex 1 was replaced from 1 September 2026.
findings.textSays: DA § 117: "Indberetning skal ske senest den 1. maj i året efter det kalenderår, indberetningen vedrører." Stk. 2 says the duty stays with the institution when it uses service providers. Neither § 111 nor § 117 mentions Annex 1 or 1 September 2026.
findings.whatToDo: The reporting duty, its contents, the 1 May deadline and the point about service providers are all carried. The sentence about Annex 1 being replaced comes from an amending order or from Annex 1 itself, neither of which is cited. Cite it, or drop the sentence from the summary.

findings.title: Deal honestly and loyally and keep commercial information clear and not misleading
findings.summarySays: Information given as part of its commercial practice must be fair, clear and not misleading, and marketing material must be clearly identifiable as marketing.
findings.textSays: § 4: "En forsikringsdistributør skal handle redeligt og loyalt over for sine kunder"; § 5: "En forsikringsdistributør skal i sin handelspraksis over for forbrugerne udvise god erhvervsskik." Neither shown provision mentions information being clear and not misleading, or marketing being identifiable as marketing.
findings.whatToDo: The first sentence of the summary is carried: § 4(1) covers honest and loyal dealing, and § 5 covers good business practice towards consumers. The second duty, on fair, clear and non-misleading information and identifiable marketing, has no text under it. The citation says §§ 4-6 but § 6 is missing, so the fix is to add § 6 (Chapter 4 of the order, which § 4(2) refers to) to the provisions shown, after checking that § 6 actually carries this duty. If it does not, drop that sentence from the summary. Also, the English of § 4 renders 'redeligt' as 'fairly'; the summary's 'honestly' matches the Danish.

findings.title: Meet the requirement for eligible liabilities that Finanstilsynet sets
findings.summarySays: A bank must hold eligible liabilities that meet the requirement Finanstilsynet sets
findings.textSays: DA § 3: "Finanstilsynet fastsætter efter høring af Finansiel Stabilitet kravet om nedskrivningsegnede passiver, jf. § 266 i lov om finansiel virksomhed ..."; §§ 5 and 13: "Finanstilsynet skal fastsætte kravet ...". Only § 9 says "skal opfylde kravet", and only for a parent that is not a resolution entity and is owned from a non-EU country.
findings.whatToDo: The cited text carries how Finanstilsynet sets and calibrates the requirement, the Annex 1 percentages and the consolidated duty for non-EU-owned parents. It does not carry the general duty on a bank to meet the requirement, which sits in § 266 of the Financial Business Act (lov om finansiel virksomhed), the provision the text itself cross-references. Add FBA § 266 to the citation.

findings.title: Publish own fees and banknote exchange rates on the website
findings.summarySays: From 20 November 2026 the order covers only deposit products, currency exchange and housing credit agreements.
findings.textSays: DA § 2: "De i §§ 3, 4, og 6 anførte oplysninger skal på klar og tydelig måde gives på pengeinstituttets hjemmeside." § 3: "Et pengeinstitut skal oplyse om størrelsen på gebyrer, som det selv fastsætter og opkræver." Neither § 2 nor § 3 says anything about a narrowed scope or 20 November 2026.
findings.whatToDo: §§ 2-3 carry the website duty for fees and banknote rates. The dated scope narrowing must come from the order's scope provision (§ 1) as amended, or from an amending order, and neither is cited. Cite that provision, or remove the sentence from the summary.

findings.title: Calculate the systemic risk buffer with the Annex 1 formula
findings.summarySays: applying the buffer rates the Minister sets to its total risk exposure amount and to the relevant subsets of exposures
findings.textSays: Original (da): "Virksomheden skal beregne sin systemiske buffer i overensstemmelse med bilag 1." English: "The undertaking must calculate its systemic risk buffer in accordance with Annex 1."
findings.whatToDo: § 2 does carry the core duty (calculate the buffer by Annex 1), but nothing in it covers the rates the Minister sets, the total risk exposure amount or the subsets of exposures. Those can only come from bilag 1, which the text cross-refers to but which is not cited. Fix: add Annex 1 (bilag 1) of BEK nr 441 af 25/04/2025 to the citation, or cut the summary back to the duty to use the Annex 1 formula.

findings.title: Ensure separate pension savings depots keep to the placement and concentration rules
findings.summarySays: placed only in the permitted instruments ... and unlisted shares only within § 23, stk. 4: at least DKK 50,000 per company and at most 25 % of the part of the customer's savings in the bank below DKK 2 million. When an investment in unlisted shares is agreed, the bank must tell the customer that it will notify the company that all future payments go to the depot.
findings.textSays: § 27: "Et pengeinstitut skal påse, at reglerne om anbringelse af midler i særskilte depoter, jf. § 23, stk. 1, 2 og 4, samt §§ 25 og 26 er overholdt." § 26, stk. 7 mentions only "Beløbsgrænserne i stk. 1 og § 23, stk. 4, nr. 2-4" without stating them.
findings.whatToDo: § 27 (duty to ensure), § 26 (20 % per issuer, 5 % for § 23(1) no. 6) and § 25 (derivatives) carry their parts. The permitted-instrument list, the unlisted-share limits (DKK 50,000, 25 %, DKK 2 million) and the duty to tell the customer about notifying the company are not in the text shown. Add the text of § 23 (stk. 1, 2 and 4), which the citation names and §§ 26(7) and 27 cross-refer to.

findings.title: Inform pool savers before and during the pool agreement, every quarter and every year
findings.summarySays: report each pool's percentage return and asset mix within 8 weeks after each quarter, and after each calendar year give ex-post cost information calculated under Article 50 of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/565 within 12 weeks
findings.textSays: § 8 only: "Ændringerne skal gennemføres med et passende varsel, og kunden skal informeres i rimelig tid inden ændringen." Neither § 3 nor § 7 says anything about quarterly or annual reporting.
findings.whatToDo: § 3 (durable medium, conclude or confirm the agreement), § 7 (guidelines, no ownership, negative returns, entry and exit, five-year returns, guarantee cover) and § 8 (notice of material changes) carry the rest of the summary. The quarterly 8-week and annual 12-week ex-post cost reporting has no text under it: add the text of § 9, which the citation names, to the provisions shown, or remove those two duties from the summary.

findings.title: Supply information to AMLA and submit to its investigations and on-site inspections
findings.summarySays: AMLA starts the first selection by 1 July 2027 and begins direct supervision six months after it publishes the list of selected entities.
findings.textSays: Art. 17(2): "shall supply the requested information without undue delay, ensuring that it is clear, accurate and complete"; Art. 18(2): "shall be subject to investigations launched on the basis of a decision of the Authority"; Art. 19(4): "shall be subject to on-site inspections on the basis of a decision of the Authority". None of Articles 17, 18 or 19 gives a date for the first selection or a six-month start for direct supervision.
findings.whatToDo: I read all three articles and agree with the first reader. They carry the duties to supply information and to submit to investigations and on-site inspections, but the second sentence of the summary, with its 1 July 2027 selection date and six-month start, has no source in the cited text. None of the three articles cross-refers to the selection process. Either add the selection-process article of Regulation (EU) 2024/1620 (Article 13, to be confirmed against the official text) to the citation, or drop that sentence from the summary.

findings.title: Use high-risk AI systems according to their instructions, with human oversight and monitoring
findings.summarySays: Systems placed on the market or put into service before 2 December 2027 are caught only if their design changes significantly afterwards.
findings.textSays: "placed on the market or put into service before the date of application of Chapter III referred to in Article 113, only if, as from that date, those systems are subject to significant changes in their designs"
findings.whatToDo: The Art. 26 deployer duties are carried and Art. 111(2) carries the grandfathering rule, but the 2 December 2027 date depends on Article 113, which is not cited. Add Article 113 to the citation.

findings.title: Assess the impact on fundamental rights before using AI for credit scoring or life and health insurance pricing
findings.summarySays: Systems placed on the market or put into service before 2 December 2027 are caught only if their design changes significantly afterwards.
findings.textSays: "placed on the market or put into service before the date of application of Chapter III referred to in Article 113, only if, as from that date, those systems are subject to significant changes in their designs"
findings.whatToDo: Art. 27(1) to (4) carries the assessment, notification and update duties, and Art. 111(2) carries the grandfathering rule, but the 2 December 2027 date depends on Article 113, which is not cited. Add Article 113 to the citation.

findings.citation: Art. 16, Art. 17(4), Art. 18(3), Art. 19(2), Art. 111(2) and Annex III point 5(b) and (c)
findings.title: Meet the provider obligations for high-risk AI systems the firm develops
findings.summarySays: Systems placed on the market or put into service before 2 December 2027 are caught only if their design changes significantly afterwards.
findings.textSays: "placed on the market or put into service before the date of application of Chapter III referred to in Article 113, only if, as from that date, those systems are subject to significant changes in their designs"
findings.whatToDo: Art. 111(2) carries the grandfathering rule but defines the cut-off only by cross-reference to Article 113; the 2 December 2027 date is nowhere in the cited text. Add Article 113 (the paragraph giving Chapter III's application date for Annex III systems) to the citation.

findings.title: Do not provide or use AI systems for prohibited practices
findings.summarySays: Two bans added by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, on AI-generated intimate imagery and child sexual abuse material, apply from 2 December 2026.
findings.textSays: Art. 5(1)(ba) and (bb) carry the two added bans ("generates or manipulates realistic images, videos, audio or similar material of an identifiable natural person's intimate parts"; "material or performance within the meaning of Article 2, points (c) and (e), of Directive 2011/93/EU"), and 5(1a) and (1b) qualify them, but no paragraph of Article 5 states when they apply; "2 December 2026" is not in the cited text.
findings.whatToDo: The prohibitions themselves are carried; the 2 December 2026 start date comes from the application provision (Article 113, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744), which is not cited. Add that application provision to the citation, or drop the date from the summary.

findings.title: Decide whether to notify a significant cyber threat to the competent authority
findings.summarySays: When it does, the notification follows the content and template laid down under Article 20.
findings.textSays: "Financial entities may, on a voluntary basis, notify significant cyber threats to the relevant competent authority when they deem the threat to be of relevance to the financial system, service users or clients." The only template wording in Article 19 is in paragraph 1: "the initial notification and reports referred to in paragraph 4 of this Article using the templates referred to in Article 20". That covers major ICT-related incident reports only, not voluntary cyber-threat notifications.
findings.whatToDo: Art. 19(2) carries the voluntary notification, but nothing in Article 19 ties a cyber-threat notification to any content or template. Add Article 20 to the citation (the article Art. 19 itself points to for the templates), or drop the summary's second sentence.

findings.title: Invest at least 55% in eligible investment assets and respect the diversification limits
findings.summarySays: These rules apply in the form set by Regulation (EU) 2023/606 from 10 January 2024; ELTIFs authorised under the previous rules are deemed compliant until 11 January 2029 or, if they raise no additional capital, indefinitely.
findings.textSays: Article 13 sets the limits ("An ELTIF shall invest at least 55 % of its capital in eligible investment assets"; 20 % per single undertaking, real asset or fund; 20 % for simple, transparent and standardised securitisations; 10 % counterparty exposure) and the exemptions in paragraph 7 ("shall not apply where ELTIFs are marketed solely to professional investors"). It says nothing about the 10 January 2024 start date or about ELTIFs authorised before then being deemed compliant until 11 January 2029.
findings.whatToDo: The 55 % floor and the diversification limits are carried. The application date and the grandfathering are not in Article 13 and Article 13 points nowhere else for them. They come from the transitional and final provisions of amending Regulation (EU) 2023/606 (Article 2), which is not cited. Either cite that provision for the sentence on grandfathering or drop the sentence from this duty's summary.

findings.title: Publish the solvency and financial condition report and keep it available
findings.summarySays: From 30 January 2027 the report has two parts, both of which must be published and easily accessible, and the website location must be notified to the supervisor (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/269).
findings.textSays: Art. 300(1) "no later than 14 weeks after the undertaking's financial year end"; Art. 301(1) "the solvency and financial condition report shall be disclosed on that website"; 301(3) "at least five years"; 301(6) "submit to the supervisory authorities ... in electronic form". No two-part report and no duty to notify the website location.
findings.whatToDo: Articles 300 and 301 carry the 14-week deadline, the website disclosure, the five years' availability, copies on request and electronic submission. The 2027 elements are absent: the two-part report and notifying the supervisor of the website location. Load the Articles 300-301 text as amended by Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/269 and cite it, or mark that sentence as coming from the uncited amendment.

findings.title: Run an effective system of governance and evaluate it regularly
findings.summarySays: from 30 January 2027 that evaluation also covers the composition, including gender balance and diversity, effectiveness and internal governance of the management body (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/269)
findings.textSays: "6. Insurance and reinsurance undertakings shall monitor, and on a regular basis evaluate, the adequacy and effectiveness of their system of governance and take appropriate measures to address any deficiencies."
findings.whatToDo: Article 258(1)(a)-(k), (4) and (6) carry the present duties: reporting lines, collective and individual qualification, staff, information systems, records, two persons running the undertaking, and the regular evaluation. Nothing in the article as shown mentions the management body's composition, gender balance or diversity. Show the Article 258(6) wording as amended by Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/269, or cite the amending provision for the 2027 element, or drop that sentence until the amended text is loaded.

findings.title: Make variable pay subject to sustainability conditions, malus and clawback
findings.summarySays: Up to 100% of variable pay must be open to malus or clawback under set criteria ... Deferral need not apply where a person's annual variable pay is at most EUR 50 000 and at most one third of total annual pay, unless the supervisor decides otherwise.
findings.textSays: "(c) the payment of a substantial portion of the variable remuneration component ... shall contain a flexible, deferred component ... that deferral period shall not be less than three years" (Art. 275(2)); the article has no point (ea) and no paragraphs (2a) or (2b).
findings.whatToDo: Article 275 is the right place: same actor, variable remuneration and deferral. But the text shown predates the 2026/269 amendment, so the cited points (2)(ea), (2a) and (2b) are missing, and so is every element of the summary: the sustainability condition, pro rata vesting, malus and clawback up to 100%, and the EUR 50 000 / one-third exemption. This sits at the edge of 'unrelated'. Replace the text with the Article 275 version as amended by Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/269, effective 30 January 2027, before showing it under this duty. Until then, hold the law's words for this obligation.

findings.title: Set out venue selection governance in the execution policy and keep an internal list of approved venues
findings.summarySays: From 12 February 2028 the order execution policy must describe the internal governance for selecting execution venues and the checks that each venue is authorised.
findings.textSays: Investment firms shall ensure that their order execution policy contains the following: (a) the internal governance procedures for the selection of execution venues; (b) the measures taken to ensure that the selected execution venues are authorised ... [no date anywhere in Article 2]
findings.whatToDo: Article 2 carries every conduct element (governance procedures, authorisation checks, internal list with approver, date, instrument classes and transaction types), but the start date of 12 February 2028 appears nowhere in it. Add the Regulation's final article (entry into force and application date) to the citation, or drop the date from the summary and show it as the instrument's application date.

findings.title: Select execution venues on client needs, order types, size, price against reference data and costs
findings.summarySays: From 12 February 2028, when choosing venues for its execution policy the firm must take account of its clients' characteristics and needs and the best execution factors
findings.textSays: When selecting execution venues for their order execution policy, investment firms shall take into account the characteristics and needs of the clients ... including in particular: (a) the availability of certain order types; (b) ... typical or relevant order sizes ... (c) ... comparison of execution prices ... with the reference data ... (d) ... fees and costs charged to the investment firm [no date anywhere in Article 3]
findings.whatToDo: Article 3(1) carries the selection duty and all four factors the summary lists, but not the 12 February 2028 start date. Add the Regulation's final article (application date) to the citation, or remove the date from the summary and rely on the instrument's application date.

findings.title: Take the prescribed indicators of manipulative behaviour into account when examining orders and transactions
findings.summarySays: When examining orders and transactions for possible market manipulation, the firm must take into account the practices set out in Annex II
findings.textSays: Art. 4: the practices set out in Indicators A(a) to A(g) of Annex I to Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 "are laid down in Section 1 of Annex II to this Regulation". The only modal verbs addressed to firms in Annex II are permissive: "market participants and competent authorities may consider a time frame that is longer or shorter than a day or a trading session" (points 1a, 4a) and "may also take into account" (point 2a); point 10: "may also be assessed and computed over a time frame that is longer or shorter than a day or a trading session".
findings.whatToDo: The cited text is the right place for the list of practices and supports the time-frame sentence, but no cited words make the firm take the indicators into account. That duty comes from Regulation (EU) No 596/2014, Article 12(3) with Annex I, which Article 4 itself refers to. Add MAR Art. 12(3) to the citation, or reword the summary so that it says Annex II spells out the practices behind the MAR indicators.

findings.title: Clear OTC derivatives in classes subject to the clearing obligation through an authorised or recognised CCP
findings.summarySays: The classes and the dates the obligation takes effect are set in Commission delegated regulations, the first from 21 June 2016.
findings.textSays: "a class of OTC derivatives that has been declared subject to the clearing obligation in accordance with Article 5(2)" and "entered into or novated on or after the date on which the clearing obligation takes effect"
findings.whatToDo: Article 4(1) to (3) carries the clearing duty, the condition that both counterparties are in scope, the CCP requirement, the clearing-member, client or indirect-clearing route and the intragroup exemption after notification. It does not say that delegated regulations set the classes and dates, and it gives no date of 21 June 2016. To correct this, cite Article 5(2) of EMIR, which Article 4(1) itself points to, together with the delegated regulation that sets the first start date. Otherwise, drop the date sentence from the summary.

findings.title: Calculate OTC derivative positions against the clearing thresholds and notify when a threshold is exceeded
findings.summarySays: The revised threshold rules of Regulation (EU) 2024/2987 for these paragraphs apply only once the new clearing threshold technical standards enter into force.
findings.textSays: Article 4a(1) to (3) states "Every 12 months, a financial counterparty ... may calculate", "immediately notify ESMA and the relevant competent authority", "establish clearing arrangements within four months", "shall remain subject to that obligation ... until that financial counterparty demonstrates" and "shall include all OTC derivative contracts ... entered into by other entities within the group". Nothing in it says when the revised rules apply.
findings.whatToDo: Article 4a carries every element of the summary except the deferred application date. That condition comes from Article 5 of Regulation (EU) 2024/2987, which the citation names but the library does not show. Add that provision's text under this duty, or drop the sentence from the summary.

findings.title: Do not provide crypto-asset, payment-instrument, acquiring, payment-initiation or e-money services to Belarusian persons
findings.summarySays: The ban began with crypto-asset wallet, account and custody services and has covered the full list since 24 October 2025
findings.textSays: Art. 1u(2): "It shall be prohibited to provide, directly or indirectly, the following services ... (a) crypto-asset services ... (b) issuing of payment instruments, acquiring of payment transactions, or payment initiation services ... (c) issuing of electronic money"; the only dates in the article are in para 3 ("as from 26 March 2025" and "As from 25 August 2026"), and they govern ownership, control and board posts in crypto-asset providers, not the service ban.
findings.whatToDo: The service ban in para 2 and the exemption in para 4 are carried. The phase-in history and the 24 October 2025 date appear nowhere in Article 1u, and nothing in it points to where they come from (presumably an amending regulation). Remove the history sentence from the summary, or cite the amending act that sets it. Take care that the summary is not read as pointing to the para 3 dates, which are about a different prohibition.

findings.title: Keep crypto-asset service customers' information confidential
findings.summarySays: must keep it confidential unless the protected person consents or the law permits disclosure
findings.textSays: "on velvollinen pitämään sen salassa, jollei se, jonka hyväksi vaitiolovelvollisuus on säädetty, anna suostumustaan sen ilmaisemiseen" (must keep it secret unless the person for whose benefit the duty of confidentiality has been laid down consents to its disclosure)
findings.whatToDo: 6 § gives only the consent exception. It also adds the ban on disclosure to the general meeting and the extension to offerors and issuers, which the summary leaves out. No disclosure-by-law exception appears anywhere in 6 §, and the section does not cross-refer to one. Either cite the Act's provision on the right or duty to disclose (most likely the following section, 7 §, which needs checking), or cut 'or the law permits disclosure' from the summary.

findings.title: Assess the consumer's creditworthiness before granting credit
findings.summarySays: From 20 November 2026 the assessment must be made thoroughly and in the consumer's interest on the basis of necessary and proportionate information on income, expenses and circumstances.
findings.textSays: FI: "Arviointi on tehtävä kuluttajan tuloja ja muita taloudellisia olosuhteita koskevien riittävien luottotietorekisteri- ja muiden tietojen perusteella." (sufficient information on income and other financial circumstances; there is no dated 2026 wording, nothing on 'thorough', 'in the consumer's interest', 'necessary and proportionate' or expenses)
findings.whatToDo: The first sentence of the summary, including the duty to update the information before an increase, is carried word for word. The second sentence describes the amended wording (CCD2) that the cited text does not contain. The corrector should add the amended version of 7:14 (or the amending act) as a cited provision once it is captured, or remove the 2026 sentence from the summary.

findings.title: Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity risks to network and information systems
findings.summarySays: Under 5 §, where an EU regulation imposes at least equivalent cybersecurity risk-management or incident-reporting duties, those apply instead.
findings.textSays: 7 §: "Toimijan on tunnistettava, arvioitava ja hallittava riskejä..."; 8 § and 9 § set the framework and control measures. None of 7-9 § mentions EU sector-specific acts taking precedence; 9 § only adds that the NIS 2 Art. 21(5) implementing acts must also be complied with.
findings.whatToDo: The core risk-management duty is fully carried by 7-9 §, but the lex specialis exception is stated in 5 §, which is not cited. Add 5 § (124/2025) to the citation, or drop the 5 § sentence from the summary.

findings.title: Ensure board members and management are reliable and competent
findings.summarySays: must have the knowledge and experience of the business, its risks and management that their role requires. Changes in management must be notified to FIN-FSA without delay.
findings.textSays: "Luottolaitoksen ylimpään johtoon kuuluvan ja avainhenkilön on oltava luotettava ja hyvämainen sekä toimittava tehtävässään rehellisesti ... on oltava kyky tehtävässä vaadittavaan itsenäiseen päätöksentekoon." The section also carries the minors, guardianship, bankruptcy and business-ban exclusions and the duty to verify before taking up duties and throughout the term.
findings.whatToDo: Reliability, the exclusions, key function holders and the verification duty are carried. The knowledge and experience requirement and the notification to FIN-FSA are not in 4 §: cite the separate competence section (likely 7 luku 4 a §) and the notification provision, or remove them from the summary. Also drop the 'from 1 October 2026' framing, since the text shown is already the extended rule.

findings.title: Maintain comprehensive governance arrangements and reliable internal control
findings.summarySays: The board approves the risk strategy and ensures reliable internal control ... The board chair may not also be the chief executive without FIN-FSA's permission, and from 1 October 2026 not at all.
findings.textSays: "Luottolaitoksen riskinoton ja riskienhallintajärjestelmien on täytettävä 9 luvun vaatimukset." / "Luottolaitoksen hallituksen puheenjohtaja ei saa samanaikaisesti toimia luottolaitoksen toimitusjohtajana."
findings.whatToDo: The governance arrangements, internal control, segregation of duties and regular assessment are carried. Board approval of the risk strategy is not in this section, which points to chapter 9 for risk-taking, so cite the relevant chapter 9 section. The text states only the flat chair/CEO ban now in force, with no FIN-FSA permission route, so the summary should say the ban applies without exception.

findings.title: Register with FIN-FSA before granting consumer credit or intermediating peer-to-peer loans
findings.summarySays: A business other than a credit institution may grant consumer credit ... Credit institutions are outside the Act.
findings.textSays: FI 3 §: "Elinkeinonharjoittaja saa myöntää kuluttajaluottoja tai asuntoyhteisöluottoja vain, jos se on rekisteröity tämän lain mukaisesti luotonantajaksi." 4 §: "Sen, joka aikoo tarjota kuluttajaluottoja ... on tehtävä ilmoitus Finanssivalvonnalle". Neither section mentions credit institutions.
findings.whatToDo: Sections 3 and 4 carry the registration duty, the notification to FIN-FSA and the register FIN-FSA keeps. The credit-institution exclusion, which is material to a bank reader, is not in them. The corrector should also cite the Act's scope provision (likely section 2, on scope and exceptions), or drop the exclusion from the summary.

findings.title: Report reportable accounts to the Tax Administration by the end of January
findings.summarySays: the Act applies first to calendar year 2026
findings.textSays: "Raportoivan finanssilaitoksen on ilmoitettava kalenterivuosittain Verohallinnolle ... kalenterivuotta seuraavan tammikuun loppuun mennessä Verohallinnon julkaisemaa sähköistä tiedonsiirtomenetelmää käyttäen." (no first year of application)
findings.whatToDo: 104 § carries the reporting duty, the nil return, the January deadline and the electronic channel, but nothing about 2026 being the first year. Cite the Act's entry-into-force or transitional provision (not identifiable from this text), or remove the first-year clause from the summary.

findings.title: Suspend or refuse suspicious transactions
findings.summarySays: If the transaction cannot be stopped, or stopping it would hinder tracing the beneficiary, it may be completed and then reported.
findings.textSays: FI: "Jos liiketointa ei voida jättää kesken taikka jos liiketoimen keskeyttäminen tai siitä kieltäytyminen todennäköisesti vaikeuttaisi liiketoimen tosiasiallisen edunsaajan selville saamista, ilmoitusvelvollinen voi suorittaa liiketoimen loppuun." EN: "... the obliged entity may complete the transaction."
findings.whatToDo: The suspend-or-refuse duty and the permission to complete are carried, but 4 luku 5 § says nothing about reporting afterwards, and it has no cross-reference to a reporting section; its only cross-reference is to the FIU's power to suspend. Add the suspicious transaction reporting section (4 luku 1 § of Act 444/2017) to the citation, or drop 'and then reported' from the summary.

findings.title: Carry out the own risk and solvency assessment regularly
findings.summarySays: from 30 January 2027 the assessment must be made at least annually
findings.textSays: FI 1 mom.: "Vakuutusyhtiön on tehtävä 12 §:ssä tarkoitettu riski- ja vakavaraisuusarvio säännöllisesti sekä viipymättä, jos yhtiön riskiprofiili on muuttunut merkittävästi." The only change from 30.1.2027 is 6 mom.: a small and non-complex company "voi tehdä ... arvioinnin vähintään joka toinen vuosi" (may assess at least every other year).
findings.whatToDo: The cited section supports 'regularly and without delay after a significant change' but contains no annual rule; its only 2027 change is a relaxation to every other year for small and non-complex companies and qualifying captives. The corrector should cite the provision that sets the annual frequency, if one exists, or reword the summary to 'regularly' and add the every-other-year derogation (6 and 7 mom.).

findings.title: Give the pre-contractual credit information on the decree's standard form
findings.summarySays: From 20 November 2026 the form opens, equally prominently, with the key items in Annex 1 parts I and II on at most two pages, part I on the first page, followed separately by the remaining items.
findings.textSays: 1 § FI: "Luotonantajan ja muun luotonvälittäjän kuin päätoimensa ohella luotonvälittäjänä toimivan myyjän tai palveluksen suorittajan on hyvissä ajoin ennen luottosopimuksen tekemistä annettava kuluttajalle 1 liitteen 1–4 kohdassa tarkoitetut tiedot. ... Kuluttajalle mahdollisesti annettavat muut tiedot on annettava erillisessä asiakirjassa." Nothing about 20 November 2026, parts I and II, equal prominence or a two-page limit.
findings.whatToDo: Confirmed: 1 § carries the actor, timing, Annex 1 items 1-4, the distance-selling item 5 and the separate-document rule, but the layout rule from 20 November 2026 is not in this text. It most likely comes from the amended version of the decree that takes effect on that date, or from Annex 1 itself. Cite that provision once it is in the library, or move the second sentence to a separate dated obligation.

findings.title: Publish a corporate governance statement with the content the decree requires
findings.summarySays: For financial years from 1 January 2025 a company within the scope of the Companies Act's board gender balance rule must also report ... Smaller companies and issuers of securities other than shares are exempt from some of these items.
findings.textSays: 7 § carries the content list (code reference, internal control of financial reporting, board and committee composition, diversity policy, gender split with the 40 per cent target under 'osakeyhtiölain 6 luvun 9 a §'), the website, departures from the code, separate-report publication and the auditor's check. It has no exemption for smaller companies or for issuers of securities other than shares, and no 1 January 2025 start date.
findings.whatToDo: The core duty is carried, but the exemptions and the 2025 start date come from uncited provisions of the decree (a scope or relief section and the transitional provisions of the amending decree). Cite those provisions, or drop the last sentence and the start date from the summary.

findings.title: Have a remuneration scheme that supports sound risk management
findings.summarySays: with specific rules for senior management, staff whose work affects its risk exposure and staff in control roles
findings.textSays: NO: "En slik godtgjørelsesordning skal ha særskilte regler for tillitsvalgte og ansatte med arbeidsoppgaver av vesentlig innvirkning på foretakets risikoeksponering."
findings.whatToDo: The rest is carried (scope over all employees and elected officers, objectives and risk tolerance, no excessive risk in § 15-1; procedures to implement, monitor and review in § 13-5(1)), but the statute names elected officers and material risk-takers, not senior management or control staff. Either reword the summary to the statute's categories or cite the remuneration regulation (finansforetaksforskriften ch. 15) that adds them.

findings.title: Act honestly, fairly and professionally and give clear, non-misleading information
findings.summarySays: An insurer, and an insurance intermediary to which the rules apply, must reasonably identify its own conflicts of interest and act honestly, fairly and professionally
findings.textSays: "skal forsikringsforetaket på rimelig vis identifisere eventuelle egne interessekonflikter og opptre ærlig, redelig og profesjonelt" (only the insurance undertaking is named; no mention of intermediaries)
findings.whatToDo: All conduct, language and currency elements are carried for insurers, but the extension to insurance intermediaries is not in § 1-5. Cite the provision that applies these rules to intermediaries, or drop the intermediary clause from the summary.

findings.title: Draw up and publish a key information document before a PRIIP is offered to retail investors
findings.summarySays: its manufacturer must draw up a key information document that meets the Regulation and publish it on its website
findings.textSays: § 2: PRIIPs-forordningen "gjelder som lov"; § 4: "Nøkkelinformasjonsdokument som distribueres i Norge, skal være på norsk. Departementet kan gjøre unntak"
findings.whatToDo: The Norwegian-language rule and its exception are carried by § 4, but the core duty to draw up and publish the KID is in neither cited section. Add PRIIPs Art. 5(1) as the source of that duty.

findings.title: Disclose inside information that directly concerns the issuer as soon as possible
findings.summarySays: must make inside information that directly concerns it public as soon as possible ... must keep the disclosed information on its website for at least five years, and may delay disclosure only on its own responsibility when all the conditions of Article 17(4) are met
findings.textSays: NO: "fastsette bestemmelser i forskrift om meldinger som skal sendes til tilsynsmyndigheten i forbindelse med utsatt offentliggjøring av innsideinformasjon etter markedsmisbruksforordningen artikkel 17 nr. 4 tredje ledd"
findings.whatToDo: § 3-1(4) only mentions a regulation-making power on delay notifications; the disclosure duty, the no-marketing rule, the five-year website rule and the delay conditions are all MAR Art. 17, which should be shown.

findings.title: Do not deal on, recommend on or unlawfully disclose inside information
findings.summarySays: No person may engage or attempt to engage in insider dealing, recommend or induce another person to engage in insider dealing, or unlawfully disclose inside information.
findings.textSays: NO: "forordning (EU) nr. 596/2014 (markedsmisbruksforordningen) ... gjelder som lov"; "Finanstilsynet er nasjonal tilsynsmyndighet"
findings.whatToDo: § 3-1 carries the incorporation and Finanstilsynet, which the summary's second sentence describes, but not the prohibition itself; show MAR Art. 14 under this duty.

findings.title: Keep an up-to-date insider list and give it to Finanstilsynet on request
findings.summarySays: must draw up a list of all persons working for it who have access to inside information, update it promptly and provide it to the competent authority as soon as possible on request
findings.textSays: NO: "forordning (EU) nr. 596/2014 (markedsmisbruksforordningen) ... gjelder som lov"
findings.whatToDo: Incorporation provision only; the insider-list duty, its contents and the written acknowledgement are MAR Art. 18, which should be shown.

findings.title: Present investment recommendations objectively and disclose interests and conflicts
findings.summarySays: must take reasonable care that the information is objectively presented and must disclose their interests or conflicts of interest concerning the financial instruments it relates to
findings.textSays: NO: "forordning (EU) nr. 596/2014 (markedsmisbruksforordningen) ... gjelder som lov med de tilpasninger som følger av vedlegg IX" (EN: "Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 (Market Abuse Regulation) ... applies as Norwegian law")
findings.whatToDo: I agree with the first reader. In the original wording, § 3-1 only makes MAR part of Norwegian law, names Finanstilsynet as the supervisor and gives the Ministry powers to make regulations. Neither the duty to present recommendations objectively nor the duty to disclose interests appears anywhere in its four paragraphs. The correction is to add the text of MAR Art. 20(1) as a provision under this obligation, keeping § 3-1 only as the route by which it applies in Norway.

findings.title: Notify managers' own-account dealings in the issuer's instruments within three business days
findings.summarySays: must notify the issuer and the competent authority ... no later than three business days after the transaction once the yearly threshold is reached, and must not trade in the 30 calendar days before an interim or year-end report
findings.textSays: NO § 3-3: "Personer som lever sammen i et ekteskapslignende forhold, skal anses likestilt med ektefeller etter markedsmisbruksforordningen artikkel 3 nr. 1 punkt 26."; "Departementet kan i forskrift fastsette bestemmelser om beløpsgrensen for inntreden av meldeplikt"
findings.whatToDo: § 3-3 carries the cohabitant rule and a power to set the threshold, but the notification duty, the three-business-day deadline, the 30-day closed period and the issuer's list and written notice are MAR Art. 19 (incl. 19(1), (5), (11)), which should be shown; the threshold amount itself comes from the regulation under § 3-3(3).

findings.title: Do not engage in or attempt market manipulation
findings.summarySays: No person may engage in or attempt to engage in market manipulation of financial instruments.
findings.textSays: NO: "forordning (EU) nr. 596/2014 (markedsmisbruksforordningen) ... gjelder som lov"
findings.whatToDo: Incorporation provision only; the prohibition is MAR Art. 15, which should be shown under this duty.

findings.title: Notify Finanstilsynet of significant net short positions in shares
findings.summarySays: must notify the competent authority each time the position reaches or falls below a notification threshold
findings.textSays: NO: "forordning (EU) nr. 236/2012 (om shortsalg og visse sider ved kredittapsbytteavtaler (shortsalgforordningen)) ... gjelder som lov" (EN: "Regulation (EU) No 236/2012 ... applies as Norwegian law")
findings.whatToDo: I agree with the first reader. § 3-5 only makes the Short Selling Regulation part of Norwegian law and gives the Ministry powers to make regulations. It contains no notification duty, no thresholds and no recipient, and unlike § 3-1(3) it does not name Finanstilsynet, so the title's naming of Finanstilsynet is not supported here either. The correction is to add SSR Art. 5 (and Art. 9 on how to notify) as provisions under this obligation, keeping § 3-5 as the route by which it applies.

findings.title: Detect suspicious orders and transactions and report them to Finanstilsynet without delay
findings.summarySays: must have effective arrangements, systems and procedures to detect and report suspicious orders and transactions ... it must notify the competent authority, which in Norway is Finanstilsynet, without delay
findings.textSays: NO: "Finanstilsynet er nasjonal tilsynsmyndighet, jf. § 19-1, og har stedlig tilsynsmyndighet etter markedsmisbruksforordningen artikkel 22."
findings.whatToDo: Only incorporation and Finanstilsynet as authority are in § 3-1; the detection arrangements and the notify-without-delay duty are MAR Art. 16(2), which should be shown.

findings.title: Carry out threat-led penetration testing when Finanstilsynet designates the firm
findings.summarySays: have its proposal of the functions to be tested approved by Norges Bank, which coordinates the test and issues the attestation of completion
findings.textSays: § 15: "Norges Bank skal utstede attest som bekrefter gjennomføring av en TLPT-test"; § 13: "Norges Bank skal godkjenne det utpekte foretakets forslag til hvilke funksjoner som skal omfattes av en TLPT-test"; § 16 speaks only of "myndighetsoppgavene som er pålagt banken i denne forskriften". None of §§ 12, 13, 15 or 16 gives Norges Bank the role of coordinating the test.
findings.whatToDo: Every other element is in the cited text: designation and frequency after hearing Norges Bank (§ 12), approval of the functions (§ 13), the attestation and Finanstilsynet's follow-up (§ 15), and cost sharing (§ 16). Norges Bank's role as test coordinator is not. Either add the section that assigns that role (the gap in the citation suggests § 14, which should be checked) or remove 'which coordinates the test' from the summary.

findings.title: As an account operator, keep the required holder, rights and proxy details in the CSD register
findings.summarySays: Under the Central Securities Depositories Act an account operator is responsible for the accounts it operates always meeting these requirements.
findings.textSays: OR § 6: "Følgende opplysninger om kontohaver og kontoen skal registreres i verdipapirsentralens register:" (§ 7 and § 8 open the same way, for "begrensede rettigheter mv." and "fullmaktsforhold"); no paragraph names the account operator (kontofører) as the one responsible, and "eventuell kontofører for kontoen" appears only as an item to be registered.
findings.whatToDo: Sections 6 to 8 carry every register detail in the summary, but not the actor that the title and the summary's last sentence rely on. The summary itself says that duty comes from the Central Securities Depositories Act. Add the Act's provision on the account operator's responsibility to the citation, or reword the title to say what the register must hold and drop the account-operator duty.
