findings.textSays: NO (3): "Henvisningene til medlemsstatenes kompetente myndigheter ... skal forstås som «Direktoratet for eksportkontroll og sanksjoner»"
findings.whatToDo: § 2(3) carries only the recipient, DEKSA. The duty to report information without delay and to cooperate (Art. 12(1)) is not in the text shown, so attach the Art. 12(1) text. Note that § 2(6) disapplies only reporting to the Commission, not reporting to DEKSA.

findings.title: Comply with EU sanctions regulations, whose breach is a criminal sanctions offence
findings.summarySays: A sanctions offence includes making funds or economic resources available to a designated person or failing to freeze them, providing services, financing or financial assistance contrary to a restriction, and entering into or continuing to perform a prohibited contract; an aggravated offence carries four months to five years in prison, and breaching a notification, information or reporting duty in a sanctions measure is at least a sanctions violation punishable by a fine.
findings.textSays: "Rangaistus ... asetusten rikkomisesta ja sen yrittämisestä säädetään rikoslain (39/1889) 46 luvun 3 a–3 d §:ssä." (EN: penalties "are laid down in chapter 46, sections 3a to 3d of the Criminal Code (39/1889)")
findings.whatToDo: Section 4 carries the first sentence of the summary (breach of Article 215 regulations and of orders under the Act is punishable under Criminal Code ch. 46 ss. 3a-3d), but the offence elements, the four-months-to-five-years range and the fine for breaching reporting duties are only in the Criminal Code. Add Criminal Code (39/1889) chapter 46, sections 3a to 3d to the citation, as section 4 itself points there, or cut the summary to the cross-reference.

findings.title: Review pre-existing individual and entity accounts for reportable holders
findings.summarySays: enhanced review for high-value accounts, and review pre-existing entity accounts
findings.textSays: "När det gäller befintliga högvärdekonton som innehas av fysiska personer, ska ett rapporteringsskyldigt finansiellt institut genomföra granskning enligt 2 § första stycket." (4 kap. 5 §); "Om något annat inte anges i 2 kap. 20 § är ett befintligt konto ett rapporteringspliktigt konto 1. om det innehas av en eller flera enheter ..." (6 kap. 1 §)
findings.whatToDo: The first reader is right. For lower-value accounts the cited text does carry the residence-address test (4 kap. 1 §) and the electronic search (4 kap. 2 §). For high-value accounts, 4 kap. 5 § requires only the electronic search, with no enhanced steps, and 6 kap. 1 § only defines when an entity account is reportable. Cite the sections of Chapter 4 after 5 § that set out the enhanced high-value review, and the Chapter 6 section that imposes the entity-account review, or narrow the summary.

findings.title: Obtain and check a tax residence self-certification from each crypto-asset user
findings.summarySays: For existing users the self-certification must be obtained by 1 January 2027.
findings.textSays: "När den rapporteringsskyldiga leverantören av kryptotillgångstjänster upprättar en kundrelation med en individuell användare av kryptotillgångar ska leverantören inhämta ett intygande ... Detta förfarande ska ha avslutats innan någon rapporteringspliktig transaktion utförs av leverantören." (7 kap. 3 § says the same for entities; neither mentions existing users or 1 January 2027)
findings.whatToDo: 7 kap. 2 and 3 §§ carry the duty for new customer relationships only; the deadline for existing users is in an uncited provision, probably the transitional provisions (övergångsbestämmelser) of SFS 2025:1377. Cite that provision, or drop the second sentence of the summary.

findings.title: Give the consumer standardised pre-contract credit information in good time
findings.summarySays: ... using the Standard European Consumer Credit Information form, on paper or another durable medium.
findings.textSays: SV 3 kap. 3 §: "Informationen enligt 1 § första stycket ska lämnas i enlighet med formuläret 'Standardiserad europeisk konsumentkreditinformation'."; 3 kap. 2 §: "Informationen ska lämnas i en handling eller i den form som konsumenten har valt enligt 4 kap. 3 §", which applies only to the repeat withdrawal information given after the agreement is concluded.
findings.whatToDo: The cited text carries the duty to give the information, the timing ("i rimlig tid") and the form, but no section says the main pre-contract information must be on paper or another durable medium. Add the provision that sets the medium (probably 4 kap. 3 §, which 3 kap. 2 § cross-refers to, but check it) or remove "on paper or another durable medium" from the summary.

findings.title: Select at least two liquidity management tools for each open-ended fund
findings.summarySays: Under the transitional rules, a manager must tell Finansinspektionen of the tools chosen no later than 30 December 2026.
findings.textSays: SV 8 kap. 3 a §: "AIF-förvaltaren ska skriftligen underrätta Finansinspektionen om de verktyg som har valts enligt första stycket." No date appears in 3 a § or 3 d §; both end only with "Lag (2026:910)."
findings.whatToDo: The selection duty, the notification of the chosen tools and the activation notice (3 d §) are all in the cited text, but the 30 December 2026 deadline is not. It comes from the transitional provisions of Lag (2026:910), so either cite those transitional provisions or take the date out of the summary.

findings.citation: 22 b kap. 2 och 3 §§ och 24 kap. 2 a §
findings.title: Report CRS reportable and undocumented accounts to Skatteverket by 15 May
findings.summarySays: Reporting financial institutions must file control statements on accounts that are reportable, and on undocumented accounts
findings.textSays: "Kontrolluppgift ska lämnas för fysiska personer och sådana enheter som avses i 2 kap. 22 § ..." (22 b kap. 3 §); "Kontrolluppgift ska också lämnas om ett sådant odokumenterat konto ..." (22 b kap. 2 §)
findings.whatToDo: The first reader is right. The reportable accounts, the undocumented accounts and the 15 May deadline are all in the cited text (22 b kap. 2 § and 24 kap. 2 a §). The filer is not named anywhere in it, even though 3 § is headed "av vem". Add the Chapter 22 b provision that names reporting financial institutions as the filer, or reword the summary so it does not rest on the actor.

findings.title: Report reportable crypto-asset users and transactions to Skatteverket by 1 April
findings.summarySays: must file control statements on reportable crypto-asset users and their transactions
findings.textSays: "Kontrolluppgift ska lämnas av en rapporteringsskyldig leverantör av kryptotillgångstjänster." (22 d kap. 3 §); "Kontrolluppgifter enligt 22 d kap. ska ha kommit in till Skatteverket senast den 1 april" (24 kap. 2 b §)
findings.whatToDo: The first reader is right. The cited text gives the filer and the 1 April deadline, but not what the statement covers (reportable crypto-asset users and their transactions). Add 22 d kap. 2 §, the "Skyldighet att lämna kontrolluppgift" section that parallels 22 a and 22 b kap. 2 §, and any "för vem" section of Chapter 22 d.

findings.citation: 22 a kap. 2 och 3 §§ och 24 kap. 2 a §
findings.title: Report US reportable accounts to Skatteverket by 15 May
findings.summarySays: Reporting financial institutions must file control statements on accounts that are reportable under the FATCA identification act
findings.textSays: "Kontrolluppgift ska lämnas för fysiska personer och sådana enheter som avses i 2 kap. 21 § ..." (22 a kap. 3 §); "Kontrolluppgift ska lämnas om ett sådant rapporteringspliktigt konto ..." (22 a kap. 2 §); "senast den 15 maj närmast följande kalenderår" (24 kap. 2 a §)
findings.whatToDo: The first reader is right. The cited text gives what is reported, for whom it is reported and the 15 May deadline. Despite the heading "av vem", none of the cited sections says who must file, so the summary's actor, reporting financial institutions, rests on an uncited provision. Cite the Chapter 22 a provision that names the filer, or drop the actor from the summary.

findings.title: Make sure consumer advisers have tested knowledge, practical experience and up-to-date skills
findings.summarySays: Advice given by securities institutions and foreign investment firms under the Securities Market Act, fund companies and AIF managers is outside these rules.
findings.textSays: 2 kap. 1-7 §§ only lay the knowledge, test, update and experience duties on the trader, e.g. 5 §: "Näringsidkaren ska säkerställa att den personal som lämnar råd uppfyller kunskapskraven i 1-4 §§ genom att se till att personalen har genomgått ett lämpligt kunskapstest". None of the seven sections mentions värdepappersinstitut, utländska värdepappersföretag, fondbolag or AIF-förvaltare, or any exclusion.
findings.whatToDo: The competence, test (with independent approval of an in-house test), update and practical-experience duties are all carried by 2 kap. 1-7 §§, but the scope exclusion is not in the cited text. Cite the regulation's scope provision in 1 kap. as well, or drop the exclusion sentence from the summary.

findings.title: Defer at least 40 percent of material risk takers' variable pay for four years, half in instruments
findings.summarySays: The deferral and instrument rules do not apply to smaller institutions that meet the size tests.
findings.textSays: 4 kap. 6-8 carry the 40 per cent for four years (6: "minst 40 procent av den rörliga ersättningen ... skjuts upp minst fyra år"), the 50 per cent in instruments (7), the retention period (8: "minst ett år") and the per-employee exemption in 6 a and 7 a ("maximalt 50 000 euro och inte motsvarar mer än en tredjedel"), but no exemption for smaller institutions.
findings.whatToDo: The institution-size exemption is a material exception not found in the cited sections. Cite the provision that exempts smaller, non-complex institutions from 4 kap. 6-8 (not identifiable from this text), or remove the last sentence of the summary.

findings.title: Report events of material significance to Finansinspektionen immediately
findings.summarySays: Major ICT incidents under DORA are reported under DORA instead.
findings.textSays: 10 kap. 1-5 carry the immediate written report (1: "ska de omedelbart rapporteras skriftligt till Finansinspektionen"), the events (2), the board's internal rules (4) and the police report (5: "Vid misstanke om brott ska ett fondbolag göra en anmälan om detta till polismyndighet eller åklagare"), but no section mentions DORA, ICT incidents or any exception to the reporting duty.
findings.whatToDo: The DORA carve-out is a material exception absent from the cited text. Add the provision that excludes major ICT-related incidents under DORA (likely a later-inserted paragraph or the chapter's scope rule; not identifiable from these sections) to the citation, or drop that sentence from the summary.

findings.title: Govern outsourcing with internal rules and written agreements that keep control and access
findings.summarySays: ICT arrangements covered by Chapter V of DORA are outside these rules.
findings.textSays: "Ett företag ska ha interna regler för att hantera sina uppdragsavtal." (10 kap. 2 a–6 §§ set the internal rules, staff competence, provider compliance, the agreement's content under 5 § points 1–11 and the written agreement; none of them excludes ICT arrangements under DORA Chapter V)
findings.whatToDo: 10 kap. 2 a–6 §§ carry the outsourcing duties in full. The DORA carve-out must come from an uncited scope or application provision (likely 10 kap. 1 § or a provision added by an amendment that implements DORA). Add that provision to the citation, or remove the last sentence of the summary.

findings.title: Set an operational risk appetite and limits, decided by the board and the CEO
findings.summarySays: ICT risks under DORA are outside these rules.
findings.textSays: 2 kap. 1-2 carry the appetite, measurable limits, board and CEO decisions and the internal rules (1: "Ett företag ska fastställa en riskaptit för sina operativa risker"; "Styrelsen ska besluta om ... riskaptiten"; "Den verkställande direktören ska besluta om ... limiterna"), with no DORA or ICT exclusion anywhere.
findings.whatToDo: The appetite, limits and internal-rules duties are carried, but the DORA exclusion has to come from an uncited scope provision (likely in 1 kap. on application). Add that provision to the citation or remove the sentence from the summary.

findings.title: Assess each borrower on defined criteria, connected clients and forward-looking repayment capacity
findings.summarySays: This applies to non-consumer credits and consumer mortgage credits.
findings.textSays: 4 kap. 1-6 carry every assessment element (1: "Ett företags kreditprövning ska baseras på väldefinierade kriterier"; 2-3 connected clients and guarantor; 4 forward-looking basis; 5 sensitivity analysis for institutions and companies; 6 adverse exchange-rate assumptions), but say nothing that limits the chapter to particular kinds of credit.
findings.whatToDo: The assessment duties are fully carried, but the scope limit to non-consumer and consumer mortgage credits comes from an uncited scope provision (likely in 1 kap.). Add that provision to the citation or remove the scope sentence from the summary.

findings.title: File the cybersecurity registration with the single point of contact, the National Defence Radio Establishment
findings.summarySays: Finansinspektionen is the supervisory authority under the act for the banking and financial market infrastructure sectors.
findings.textSays: 5 §: "En anmälan enligt 2 kap. 2 § cybersäkerhetslagen (2025:1506) ska göras till den gemensamma kontaktpunkten enligt 23 §"; 23 §: "Försvarets radioanstalt ska vara gemensam kontaktpunkt enligt artikel 8.3 i NIS 2-direktivet". Neither section mentions Finansinspektionen or supervision.
findings.whatToDo: The filing duty and FRA as the recipient are fully carried. The statement that FI is the supervisor for banking and financial market infrastructure comes from the ordinance's provision naming the supervisory authorities, which is not cited. Add that section to the citation, or drop the sentence from the summary.

findings.title: Calculate the annual percentage rate of charge on consumer credit with the directive formula and assumptions
findings.summarySays: and from 20 November 2026, under the Consumer Credit Act (2026:1011), with the formula in Part I of Annex III to Directive (EU) 2023/2225
findings.textSays: "Den effektiva räntan enligt konsumentkreditlagen (2010:1846) ska beräknas i enlighet med den matematiska formel som anges i del I av bilaga I till ... direktiv 2008/48/EG" (Förordning 2016:1039); none of 2, 3 or 4 § mentions the 2026 Act or Directive (EU) 2023/2225.
findings.whatToDo: 2-4 §§ carry the current formula, the exclusion of breach charges, the account-cost rule and the assumptions. The rule from 20 November 2026 comes from an amending ordinance or a new wording that is not cited. Either cite that future wording, with its own effective date, once it is in the library, or remove the 2026 sentence from the summary until then.

findings.title: Give consumer credit pre-contract information on the prescribed standard form
findings.summarySays: From 20 November 2026, under the Consumer Credit Act (2026:1011), it is the form in Annex I to Directive (EU) 2023/2225, made available by Konsumentverket.
findings.textSays: "Det formulär som det hänvisas till i 8 § andra stycket konsumentkreditlagen (2010:1846) har den utformning som framgår av bilaga II till Europaparlamentets och rådets direktiv 2008/48/EG"; nothing on the 2026 Act, Directive (EU) 2023/2225 or Konsumentverket.
findings.whatToDo: 1 § carries the current form rule (Annex II to 2008/48/EC) but not the 2026 form or Konsumentverket's role. Cite the amended or future wording that sets them, as a separate version with its effective date, or drop the 2026 sentence from the summary.
